senses.gloss: (מָסַס) unto him who refuses (used homiletically as an independent word, meaning in Greek) dog.
units: Sabb. 63ᵇ (ref. to Job VI, 14, v. Targ. a. l.) שכן בל״י קורין לכלב ל׳ for in Greek they call a dog lms (?). [The sentence is an interpolated gloss, v.
Y. B. Kam. VII, end, 6ᵃ; Keth. 96ᵃ; Gen. R. s. 76, end. The interpolator may have had in mind λοιμός ‘a plague’, used as adj. in LXX for בליעל.]
